name: cpu-profiling-example
description: Exercises the agent's CPU profiler so samples carry span:/trace_id/span_id labels, sent to the New Relic staging collector.

scripts.start: npm run build && node -r newrelic --env-file .env dist/index.js
scripts.start:source-map: npm run build && NEW_RELIC_PROFILING_SOURCE_MAPPING_ENABLED=true node -r newrelic --env-file .env dist/index.js
